SHARED-F-2-S77.title: Consent Schema and Tier Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S77.description: Define and persist the two-tier HIPAA consent schema including Tier 1 (de-identified usage) and Tier 2 (identified storage). Establish data contracts, MongoDB document structure, and Pydantic models for consent capture, storage, and retrieval.

SHARED-F-2-S78.title: Consent Core Logic and Enforcement Engine
SHARED-F-2-S78.description: Implement core consent enforcement logic including tier validation, escalation rules (Tier 1 to Tier 2), and gating of identifiable data storage. Ensure integration with de-identification pipeline and conversation summarization workflows.

SHARED-F-2-S79.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S79.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier behavior, enforcement of de-identification, prevention of unauthorized identifiable storage, and correct interaction with dependent services (lead capture, unknown questions).
